item.title: Man in custody after APD execute murder arrest warrant in West Campus
item.description: The Austin Police Department said its SWAT team was responding to a barricaded subject call in the West Campus area near Lamar Boulevard.

item.title: After win at COTA, Tyler Reddick pays tribute to victims, families of Austin mass shooting
item.description: Reddick became the first driver in NASCAR history to win the first three races of a season, holding off Shane van Gisbergen to claim the DuraMax Texas Grand Prix. While he had to stay focused on the track, he gave a heartfelt tribute in an exclusive interview from victory lane with KXAN's Grace Reader.

item.title: Third's time a charm: Tyler Reddick makes NASCAR history at COTA
item.description: Reddick captured his third consecutive Cup Series race to start a season, holding off Shane van Gisbergen in the DuraMax Texas Grand Prix at Circuit of the Americas. It wasn't quite as dramatic as his first two victories of the season, and Reddick led 58 of the 95 laps starting from the pole position. He finished fifth after 45 laps to close out Stage 2 while dropping back to the 18th spot after the first 20 laps.
